rows.title: Multimodal Therapy With Metformin, Inositol and Dietary Restriction Improves Insulin Resistance and Endocrine Outcomes in Women With Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
rows.focus: Randomized 12-week trial in 192 women with PCOS/PMOS compared metformin, inositol, calorie restriction, and combination therapy. All groups improved metabolic/endocrine measures; combination therapy produced the largest early changes. Short follow-up limits conclusions about sustained outcomes.

rows.title: Efficacy of a probiotic formula in the management of menopausal symptoms and quality of life: a randomized controlled trial.
rows.focus: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 245 peri/postmenopausal women found a three-strain probiotic formula was associated with modest improvement in Menopause Rating Scale and Utian quality-of-life scores over three months; the Cervantes score did not differ significantly.

rows.title: Effect of vitamin D combined with probiotic-assisted insulin pump on glucose-lipid metabolism, intestinal flora and pregnancy outcome in gestational diabetes mellitus.
rows.focus: Randomized study in 150 patients with gestational diabetes compared insulin plus vitamin D with insulin plus vitamin D and probiotics. The combination group showed better glycemic/lipid measures, microbiota changes, and fewer adverse pregnancy outcomes; authors call for larger blinded multicenter confirmation.
